title: Trip Planner
tagline: A shared trip plan where friends add ideas, vote on conflicts and pack together
summary: I built Trip Planner in August 2025 so a group trip didn't have to live in a giant group chat. Everyone signs in, adds plans to a day-by-day itinerary, votes when two plans clash, and adds to a shared packing list. Changes show up for everyone right away.

hero.alt: Trip Planner itinerary showing a Finger Lakes weekend organized into dated cards with events and voting controls
hero.caption: A weekend trip, one card per day.

sections.heading: Planning outside the group chat
body: Anyone on the trip can add an event with a time, place, notes or a link, and everyone else sees it without refreshing. I kept the front end to plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript so it stayed small and simple.

sections.heading: Voting on conflicts
body: If two plans land at the same time, they turn into options and everyone votes them up or down. You can only delete your own plans, unless you're an admin, or everyone else has voted it down.

media.alt: Trip Planner itinerary with two competing 11 AM activities grouped as options and visible upvote and downvote controls
media.caption: Two 11 AM plans, turned into a vote.

sections.heading: Packing together
body: There's also a shared packing list, split into items, snacks and other stuff. You can heart the good ideas, and it remembers who hearted what.

media.alt: Trip Planner packing page with categorized cards for a first-aid kit, board games, snacks, coffee, and a shared playlist
media.caption: The shared packing list.

sections.heading: Under the hood
body: Live updates use Server-Sent Events: when anything changes, the server tells every open browser to refresh that part of the page. Everything is saved in JSON files with a lock, so two people saving at the same time can't wipe each other out. A real database would be the next step if more than a few friends used it.

media.alt: Trip Planner account administration page listing four made-up users with password reset, role, and deletion controls
media.caption: Admins can add people and reset passwords.

media.alt: Add Event dialog in Trip Planner with fields for time, title, description, location, and link
media.caption: Adding an event. Only the title is required.
